commit.message:
Backfill all children of a book at once and show them in its table

C-u on sp-litnotes-meta-backfill-children, or the new
sp-litnotes-meta-backfill-all-children, makes the notes of every BibTeX
entry that cross-references the book without picking. Afterwards the
note gets a collection-query-table block (book-sections, or
collection-articles for a collection) if it has none, and the block is
refreshed so the new notes show.

commit.message:
🐛 fix: escape @key, $ and <key> from PR text so typst compile passes

typst compile failed with "label `<key>` does not exist" on a PR titled
"Show the reference of @key links on hover" and on the matching commit
line: Typst reads @name as a reference. $...$ (math) and <name> (label)
are the same kind of clash, and how much of this pandoc escapes depends
on its version.

- Swap @, $ and < for placeholders before pandoc, then turn them into
  \u{40}, \u{24} and \u{3c} in the Typst source (valid in markup and in
  link-target strings). Fenced and inline code keep the real characters.
- Turn off tex_math_dollars in the GFM stage: "$HOME/$PATH" in a PR body
  was being rewritten as a math fragment.
- Warn with line numbers if an unescaped @name is still left.

Checked on made-up JSON modelled on the report (titles, comments, commit
lines, tables, code fences, nested fences, link targets, private-use
characters). Not checked by compiling: typst is not installed here.

commit.message:
✨ feat: gh-pr-pdf only fetches what changed after the first run

Later runs pass github-backup -i, so only new data is requested, and
render again only the pull requests whose JSON changed. The PDF is still
rebuilt from every org file (local, no API).

- backup/.gh-pr-pdf-state.json: last full fetch, the options it used, a
  hash per rendered PR. A failed fetch leaves it as it was.
- Full fetch when there is no earlier one, with --full, when the options
  differ (-i does not backfill a new flag), and every --full-every days
  (default 30), because the github-backup docs warn that a failed run
  leaves a gap in an incremental backup. A full fetch deletes the
  last_update / reviews_last_update checkpoints first.
- Discussions stay a full fetch each time.
- Org files of PRs that vanish from the backup are removed.

Checked against a stand-in github-backup that logs how it is called:
first run, unchanged rerun, one changed PR, --full, changed options,
40-day-old state, failed fetch, vanished PR, corrupt state. Not checked
against the real github-backup. See gh-pr-pdf/README.org, "Not run".
